name: Infiltration
summary: In Tarren Mill, Krusk has at last heard word and rumor of Gol'dir. The Syndicate keeps moving the orc prisoner, and Krusk sends you to its large camp just north of town to bring back whatever information you can find.

sections.title: Word of Gol'dir
sections.body: Krusk has at last heard word and rumor of Gol'dir, an orc prisoner held by the Syndicate. Its humans keep moving him, but the search has narrowed to their large camp just north of Tarren Mill. Krusk sends you there to find whatever information you can and carry it back. With each day, he fears Gol'dir's prospects grow darker.

sections.title: News for Krusk
sections.body: The information you bring back tells Krusk where Gol'dir is held. The camp lies not far from Tarren Mill, and Krusk hopes its defenders are less prepared than the captors who took him and the others the first time.

faq.answer: Krusk is looking for Gol'dir, an orc held prisoner by the Syndicate. Its humans keep moving him about.

faq.q: Where does Krusk send you to find the information?
aliases: where do i go for infiltration
faq.answer: Krusk sends you to the Syndicate's large camp just north of Tarren Mill to bring back whatever information you can find about Gol'dir's whereabouts.

faq.q: What information is needed to locate Gol'dir?
aliases: what do i need to find
what item is krusk looking for
faq.answer: Anything that shows where Gol'dir is can help locate him. A Syndicate missive is what you bring back to Krusk.

aliases: who is holding the orc captive
faq.answer: The Syndicate is holding Gol'dir, and its humans keep moving him about.
